Edgar Rice Burroughs, Tarzan and the Golden Lion.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edgar-rice-burroughs/tarzan-and-the-golden-lion

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edgar Rice Burroughs, the author, died 1950 (Wikidata Q148234, P570 = 1950-03-19).

First publication of the text used: 1922, in the United States; United States infobox, publisher A. C. McClurg, 1922-1923. SE colophon: 'Tarzan and the Golden Lion was published in 1923 by Edgar Rice Burroughs.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1922, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2017.
- Country of origin (United States): the country of first publication is the United States, so the rule above settles the country of origin too.
